changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Score') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Score]( [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsNewScore_EffectiveDate] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [Value] [decimal](5, 3) NOT NULL, [RunDate] [datetime] NULL, [EndDate] [date] NULL, [ScoreType] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricScore] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AssetUid] ASC, [ScoreType] ASC, [EffectiveDate] DESC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Score' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Uid') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] ADD [Uid] uniqueidentifier constraint DF_MetricScore_Uid default(newid()) not null END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Score' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'AllocationUid') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] ADD [AllocationUid] uniqueidentifier null END
if exists (select * from sys.key_constraints where name = 'PK_MetricScore') begin alter table [metrics].[Score] drop constraint [PK_MetricScore] alter table [metrics].[Score] add constraint [PK_MetricScore] primary key nonclustered ( [Uid] asc ) end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' and CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'UQ_MetricScore') begin alter table [metrics].[Score] add constraint UQ_MetricScore unique clustered ( [AssetUid], [ScoreType], [EffectiveDate] ); end
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Score' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'Uid') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricScore_Uid] ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] DROP COLUMN [Uid] END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Score' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'AllocationUid') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] DROP COLUMN [AllocationUid] END
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' and CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'UQ_MetricScore') begin alter table [metrics].[Score] drop constraint UQ_MetricScore end
if exists (select * from sys.key_constraints where name = 'PK_MetricScore') begin alter table [metrics].[Score] drop constraint [PK_MetricScore] alter table [metrics].[Score] add constraint [PK_MetricScore] primary key clustered ( [AssetUid] ASC, [ScoreType] ASC, [EffectiveDate] DESC ) end
